set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: SITE01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Product owner with institutional operator and curator

Outcome: A named deployment brief replacing planning assumptions with the selected institution's actual needs.

Acceptance:
- Record hosting, identity provider and external-collaborator model, data classification, permitted source collections, retention/withdrawal obligations and support hours.
- Name acceptance owners and record capacity, growth, availability and recovery targets, distinguishing scientific-data RPO from restrictive-policy durability.
- Explicitly reconcile beta scope with PRD targets and original pilot gates; if DICOM/XNAT or visualization is essential, make C01/W03 a dependency of program completion. Unavailable real inputs remain open; do not invent acceptance.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#1-what-we-can-responsibly-stand-up
- docs/prd.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: SITE01: Define institutional beta scope, owners and acceptance envelope
